payload.transcript: [PRIVATE_SYNTHETIC_MARKER] Ada: Let's circle back to Atlas v2. The data partitioning strategy seems solid, but I'm concerned about the write path latency under peak load for Acme [TRANSCRIPT_SYNTHETIC_MARKER]. Ben: Agreed on that point. My team owned the initial PoC for Geo-Partitioning, and we saw ~150ms p99 latency increase during our simulated 2x traffic spike test last week. The proposal was to use a dedicated Cross-Region Replication Plane [TRANSCRIPT_SYNTHETIC_MARKER]... [DEBATE START: Infrastructure Cost vs RTO/RPO trade-off]. Transcript Excerpt (Conflict): Mira: "The current setup hits our RTO of 5 mins on the Read Replica. If we replicate to a secondary region via Linkerd, that's ~30 seconds out-of-band. But", "This adds $800k/year in cross-region egress fees."""
